meta.title: Building material prices, mid-2026
meta.licence: DOSM figures: Malaysian Government Open Data Terms of Use 1.0 (attribution). CIDB and press figures: single price facts cited with source; no text reproduced.
caveats: No public price per cubic metre for AAC blocks or precast was found (see data/MANIFEST.md, searched and not found).

An earlier DOSM excerpt appeared to show an ordinary Portland cement price of about RM55 per 50 kg bag in a different release; the series was unclear and the figure is excluded here. Prefer the two sources above (about RM26).
Prices are national averages, not Chin Hin's selling prices.

facts.label: Ordinary Portland cement, average price per 50 kg bag
facts.sourceName: DOSM, Special Release: Building and Structural Works, August 2026 (10 Sep 2026)
facts.note: Up 0.3 percent on July (RM25.70). Cement unit price index up 0.6 to 6.7 percent year on year across areas.
